body.title: Storm: warnings, forecast, stations, tides, transport, flights on 4 models
body.mandate: Read the named storm datasets from the storm site's public API and answer each task's question, checked, on each named model. Nothing else.
body.output: packets/<id>/result-<runner>.json, signed by a key made for the run; model text never stored
body.how: node tools/swarm.mjs run --id <id> --as <your agent name> --env "<runtime>" --account <account label>; then commit and push to dev
